description: Defines interfaces and data structures for package management, including download, install, lock, unlock, and configuration operations within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for runtime environment, including memory limits, environment variables, and debug settings.

classes.name: IPackageDownloader
classes.description: Interface for package download operations, status notifications, and progress reporting.

classes.name: IPackageInstaller
classes.description: Interface for package installation, uninstallation, listing, and configuration.

classes.name: IPackageHandler
classes.description: Interface for locking, unlocking, and retrieving info about packages.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Initiates a package download from a URL with specified options.

methods.name: GetStorageInformation
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and used space information.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package with specified metadata and file locator.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by package ID.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration metadata for a package.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Gets the installation state of a package.

methods.name: GetConfigForPackage
methods.description: Retrieves configuration details for a specific package.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package with a reason, returning lock ID and unpacked path.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock status and related info for a package.
